strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_AIRTIMEACHI: Ut Sorceress, mane in aere per 30 secundas sine contactu terrae.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_ECLIPSEACHI: Ut Sorceress, vince ludum in Eclipse 8.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_FAEACHIEVEM: Ut Sorceress, tene 10 Bustling Fungus simul in Rainstorm vel difficultate superiore.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_MASTERYACHI: Ut Sorceress, vince ludum aut te ad obeliscum dele in Monsoon.
strings.ACHIEVEMENT_FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SPEEDACHIEV: Ut Sorceress, serva velocitatem volatus saltem 70 m/s per 2 secundas.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_DESCRIPTION:
Sorceress est maga mobilis brevis distantiae quae artibus arealibus turbas hostium infirmorum superat.<color=#CCD3E0>

< ! > Flamma Umbrarum est effectus cumulabilis qui damnum per tempus infligit et parum sanat quemlibet hostem affectum laedentem.

< ! > Utere Laceratione ut magnas turbas hostium proximorum efficaciter vincas.

< ! > Iactus Umbrae hostes ad distantiam tutam repellere aut propius trahere potest.

< ! > Nova Curvatio brevem invulnerabilitatem dat et hostes proximos laedit. Utere ea ut in locum tutum transeas aut damnum additum infligas.

< ! > Puteus Gravitatis magnum damnum in area infligit, sed te immobilem reddit.</color>
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_NO_JUMP_DESCRIPTION: Sorceress cadere labi potest per 5 secundos. Nonnulli impetus <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicare possunt. Pennae Hopoo in 0.5 secunda temporis volatus maximi convertuntur.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_NORMAL_JUMP_DESCRIPTION: Sorceress cadere labi potest per 5 secundos. Nonnulli impetus occasionem habent ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicent. Quaevis penna Hopoo unum saltum dat.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_OUTRO_FLAVOR: ..et sic abiit, novos mundos inquirens quaerens.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_PASSIVE_DESCRIPTION: Sorceress cadere labi potest per 5 secundos. Nonnulli impetus occasionem habent ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicent.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_PRIMARY_SLASH_DESCRIPTI: <style=cIsUtility>Flexibilitas</style>. <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. Verbera, <style=cIsDamage>200% damni</style> inferens cum occasione 50% ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicet. Tertius quisque ictus Flammam Umbrarum applicat, <style=cIsUtility>parvum temporis volatus</style> restituit et <color=#9933CC>duplex damnum</color> infert.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_PRIMARY_WHIP_DESCRIPTIO: <style=cIsUtility>Flexibilitas</style>. <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. Emitte radium transfixientem temporis brevis sine fine, <style=cIsDamage>200% damni</style> inferens cum occasione 50% ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicet.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SCEPTER_RAM_DESCRIPTION: <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. <style=cIsUtility>Gravis</style>. Dimidium temporis volatus restituit. Se impetum antee per 1.5 secundos, extendens per 0.5 pro quoque ictu, septum 20% auget et hostes in quos impingis <style=cIsDamage>200-2500% damni</style> inferens cum velocitate motus crescens. <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicat. 3 onera tenet.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SCEPTER_WELL_DESCRIPTIO: Dimensionem sacculare circum te crea, vicinissimos hostes in centrum trahens et omnibus hostibus intra <style=cIsDamage>160% damni</style> saepe inferens velocitatem impetus augens. Parvam habet occasionem ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> per ictum applicet. In fine erumpe, <style=cIsDamage>400% damni</style> inferens.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SECONDARY_GUN_DESCRIPTI: Emitte sagittam spectrale, <style=cIsDamage>540% damni</style> inferens. In ictu foramen nigrum creat quod hostes vicinos in se trahit. Si dum lapsu utitur, impetum tuum in ictum redirigit.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SPECIAL_PILLAR_DESCRIPT: <style=cIsUtility>Flexibilitas</style>. <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. Evoca radium energiae, omnibus hostibus intra <style=cIsDamage>700% damni</style> per 0.5 secundos inferens. In vicinum terram intendens piliorem columnam evocat quae <style=cIsDamage>duplum damni</style> infert.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SPECIAL_RAM_DESCRIPTION: <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. <style=cIsUtility>Gravis</style>. Se impetum antee per 1.5 secundos, septum 10% auget et hostes in quos impingis <style=cIsDamage>200-2500% damni</style> inferens cum velocitate motus crescens. <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> applicat. 2 onera tenet.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_SPECIAL_WELL_DESCRIPTIO: Dimensionem saccarem circum te crea, saepe omnibus hostibus intra <style=cIsDamage>160% damni</style> inferens velocitatem impetus augens. Parvam habet occasionem ut <color=#9933CC>Flammam Umbrarum</color> per ictum applicet.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_UTILITY_LAUNCH_DESCRIPT: <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. <style=cIsUtility>In aerum surge</style>, totum temporis volatus restituens.
strings.FROSTHEX_ASTERIA_UTILITY_WARP_DESCRIPTIO: <color=#9933CC>Aerea</color>. <style=cIsUtility>Curvatio brevis</style>, in fine erumpens <style=cIsDamage>600% damni</style> inferens. 2 onera tenet.
